text:
Ashley: quick async standup — morning check. What I did: rolled a small +6 GPU buffer in us-west-prod (non-disruptive). Blockers: eu-west quota still pending from cloud support (ticket #CS-8891). Today: want to decide spot/preemptible strategy for regional burst capacity and set canary thresholds. Who has current headroom numbers for eu-west and ap-south?

Devin: uploaded the provisioning change to the tf workspace, should add a burst pool and a spot fallback policy. Planning a short canary after approval. snippet:```hcl
resource "redwood_burst_pool" "eu_west_burst" {
  region = "eu-west-1"
  instance_type = "a100-v4"
  min_size = 0
  max_size = var.burst_count
}
```

Marta: noted re: ticket CS-8891, account team replied, ETA ~48h for quota increase (+12 A100 GPUs). I've asked to expedite; gave them expected start time for canary.

Suresh: saw AZ imbalance in eu-west-1 — us-east-1a is at 92% utilization while 1b and 1c are 40-55%. Suggest shifting prewarm pods to 1b for the next 6h test window to reduce preemption risk. Proposed quick patch:```bash
kubectl patch deployment gpu-prewarm -n redwood -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"aws.az-prefer":"eu-west-1b"}}}}}'
```

infra-bot: [alert] preemptible_churn spike detected: eu-west-1 preemptible churn +8.2% in last 30m. Dashboard: https://internal.redwood.dev/dashboards/preemptible-churn?region=eu-west-1

Oliver: tagged on the provisioning PR (https://git.internal/redwood/provisioning/pull/421) — need a quick CR for the spot-fallback logic. @Devin can you add a short unit test?

Devin: yep, will add test for fallback selection (i'll push before my 11:00 UTC meeting). I can run a micro-canary: 40 spot instances for 30m, cap burst QPS to 10k, monitor latency and preemptions. If churn >5% revert and fall back to on-demand.

Ashley: sounds good — decision points: 1) run micro-canary in eu-west at 11:15 UTC, 2) if ticket not approved by then, use spot fallback but set aggressive revert (churn>5%), 3) Suresh to run AZ rebalance script if preemption rises.

Marta: I'll follow up with account team and update ticket; if they approve earlier we can convert to reserved short-term burst.

Suresh: i'll prepare the AZ rebalance playbook and list of safe-to-move queues (llm-training-low, batch-eval, prewarm). Will run a dry-run tomorrow 06:30 UTC unless anyone objects.

Oliver: done — gave PR review with two small comments, LGTM otherwise. :thumbsup:

Ashley: summary/action items -> 1) Devin: add unit test + run 11:15 UTC micro-canary (40 spot instances, 30m). 2) Marta: continue escalation on CS-8891 and update here. 3) Suresh: AZ rebalance dry-run 06:30 UTC tomorrow + playbook link. 4) Oliver: merge after Devin's test and canary looks green. 5) infra-bot: keep monitoring and post another alert if churn >4%.

Ashley: any other blockers or objections? If not, I'll mark this thread resolved for today and post results after the canary finishes.
